claim.statement: Cross-cycle temporal pair source (concepts within window=3 cycles from real BGE substrate emit stream) produces downstream trainability ≥ +0.10 separation on a 3-cluster (physics/memory/language) synthetic held-out test corpus.
claim.operationalization: Build pairs from Phase 1c capture: for each pair of cycles (i, j) with |i-j| ≤ 3, pair every canonical from cycle i with every canonical from cycle j (deduplicated). Cap at 5000 pairs. Train RealtimeContrastiveTrainer for 10 epochs. Encode 24 test words (3 clusters × 8 words). Compute within-cluster vs cross-cluster mean cosine.
claim.h0: cross-cycle pair source produces sep < 0.10 OR < 0 (no signal / collapse)

preregistration.analysis_plan: Pre-registered per ROADMAP_2026_05_18.md Phase 3. Cross-cycle pair source extracted from Phase 1c capture with window=3, max 5000 pairs. Trained 10 epochs. Tested on 3-cluster synthetic (physics/memory/language).

detail.interpretation: REFUTED at strict threshold; native sep = -0.0000 indicates representation collapse on held-out 3-cluster test corpus. Same collapse pattern as Family DD Path A v1/v2/v3 (combined L2+L3+Alex). Cross-cycle pair source has 5000 pairs / 283 unique canonicals = ~18 pairs per canonical — high pair-redundancy on narrow vocabulary drives NT-Xent to trivial collapsed solution.

detail.family_dd_pattern: REFUTED at -0.2052 (Path A v1, v2, v3 all same delta)
detail.interpretation: Both share the same architectural failure mode: NT-Xent trainer on substrate-derived pairs with narrow vocabulary collapses. Phase 3 is consistent with Family DD's empirically-binding constraint: pair-volume + vocabulary-breadth are needed together; either alone produces collapse on held-out test.

verdict.reasoning: separation=-0.0000 < 0.10 threshold AND collapsed to ~0. Cross-cycle pair source alone is insufficient for held-out trainability. Consistent with Family DD Path A v1/v2/v3 collapse pattern.
